title: 听力挑战 · 讲述奋斗故事

rounds.speaker: 朋友
rounds.line: How did you manage to finish the long race yesterday?
rounds.lineCn: 昨天你是怎么坚持跑完全程的?

grammar.name: 动名词短语作主语
grammar.note: Working hard every day 是动名词短语作主语,谓语动词用单数。

options.text: Working hard every day helped me keep going.
options.feedback: 动名词短语作主语,说明坚持的原因。

options.text: Work hard and you will win.
options.feedback: 祈使句在给别人建议,没有回答自己的方法。

options.text: I finished the race last year.
options.feedback: 重复已知信息,没有解释坚持的原因。

rounds.speaker: 朋友
rounds.line: What made you start your own small business back then?
rounds.lineCn: 当年是什么促使你创办自己的小生意?

grammar.name: 分词作状语表原因
grammar.note: Seeing... 现在分词短语作状语,说明原因,相当于 Because I saw...

options.text: Seeing my parents struggle, I decided to act.
options.feedback: 分词短语作原因状语,逻辑清晰。

options.text: My business is growing very fast.
options.feedback: 谈发展结果,没有回答创业动机。

options.text: I will start a new business next year.
options.feedback: 将来时谈新计划,答非所问。

rounds.speaker: 朋友
rounds.line: How did you feel when you finally succeeded in the end?
rounds.lineCn: 你最终成功的时候是什么感受?

grammar.name: 分词作状语表伴随
grammar.note: Being praised 分词短语表示伴随情况,补充说明成功时的情境。

options.text: Being praised by the team, I felt truly proud.
options.feedback: 分词短语作伴随状语,描述感受自然贴切。
一般现在时谈日常状态,与成功时刻无关。
抽象议论,没有描述自己的感受。
